data.title: 神罚 · 清晨厨房的爱心煎蛋
data.description: 温馨的现代公寓厨房内，阳光穿过透明纱帘。神罚身穿浅灰针织裙外系棉麻围裙，端着刚出锅的爱心煎蛋转头对你甜甜微笑，嘴角沾着一点面粉，满心欢喜。
data.action: holding frying pan with fried egg, turning head with sweet innocent smile, flour smudge on cheek, domestic morning light
data.lighting: soft natural morning sunlight filtering through sheer curtains
data.mood: tender domestic warmth and pure romantic devotion
data.promptProse: Modernia cooks breakfast in a bright sunny kitchen wearing an apron over a knit dress, holding a pan with a fried egg and smiling sweetly at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Modernia holding a frying pan in a warm morning kitchen with a sweet smile.
